cookiePolicyPage.subtitle: Understanding how we use cookies to enhance your experience.
cookiePolicyPage.introduction: This Cookie Policy explains how [Your Bakery Name] ('we', 'us', or 'our') uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website [YourWebsiteURL.com]. It explains what these technologies are and why we use them, as well as your rights to control our use of them.
cookiePolicyPage.contactForQuestions: For any further questions regarding our use of cookies, please feel free to reach out.

section1.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
section1.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet, mobile) when you visit certain websites. They are widely used to make websites work, or work more efficiently, as well as to provide information to the owners of the site. Cookies make your Browse experience better by allowing the website to remember your actions and preferences (such as login, language, font size and other display preferences) over a period of time, so you don't have to keep re-entering them whenever you come back to the site or browse from one page to another.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Cookies
section2.content: We use cookies for a variety of reasons detailed below. Unfortunately, in most cases, there are no industry standard options for disabling cookies without completely disabling the functionality and features they add to this site. It is recommended that you leave on all cookies if you are not sure whether you need them or not in case they are used to provide a service that you use.
section2.subpoint1Text: These are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms.
section2.subpoint2Text: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site.
section2.subpoint3Text: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages.
section2.subpoint4Text: These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites.

section3.title: 3. Types of Cookies We Use
section3.content: Session Cookies: These are temporary cookies that expire once you close your browser. They are used to manage your session on our site.
section3.persistentCookies: Persistent Cookies: These remain on your device for a set period or until you delete them. They help us recognize you as a returning visitor and remember your preferences.
section3.thirdPartyCookies: Third-Party Cookies: These are set by domains other than the one you are visiting. We may use third-party services that place cookies on your device to help us analyze how our site is used.

section4.title: 4. How to Manage Cookies
section4.content: You can control and manage cookies in various ways. Please keep in mind that removing or blocking cookies can impact your user experience and parts of this website may no longer be fully accessible.
section4.subpoint1Text: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings preferences. You can set your browser to refuse cookies, delete cookies, or alert you when cookies are being sent.
section4.subpoint2Text: You can also opt-out of certain third-party cookies by using tools provided by the Network Advertising Initiative or the Digital Advertising Alliance.

section5.title: 5. Changes to This Cookie Policy
section5.content: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We encourage you to review this page periodically for the latest information on our cookie practices.

post1.title: The Secret to Perfect Egyptian Basbousa
post1.excerpt: Discover the traditional techniques and special ingredients that make for an unforgettable Basbousa, a true taste of Egypt.
post1.content:
Basbousa, a sweet semolina cake soaked in syrup, is a beloved dessert across the Middle East, especially in Egypt. Achieving that perfect texture – moist yet crumbly, and wonderfully fragrant – can be a delightful culinary adventure. 

**Key Ingredients & Their Roles:**
- **Semolina (السميد):** The star of the show. Coarse semolina generally yields a more textured cake, while fine semolina results in a smoother finish.
- **Ghee or Butter (السمن أو الزبدة):** Ghee provides an authentic, rich flavor.
- **Yogurt or Milk (الزبادي أو الحليب):** Adds moisture.
- **Coconut (جوز الهند - اختياري):** For flavor and texture.

**The Syrup (الشربات أو القطر):**
Crucial. Hot syrup over hot cake for softness.

**Tips for Perfection:**
1.  Don't overmix.
2.  Rest the batter.
3.  Spread evenly.
4.  Score before baking.
5.  Bake until golden.
6.  Pour syrup immediately.
7.  Cool completely. Patience is key!

post2.title: A Journey Through French Pâtisserie Classics
post2.excerpt: From éclairs to macarons, explore the rich history and delicate artistry of iconic French pastries.
post2.content:
French pâtisserie is renowned worldwide for its elegance, precision, and exquisite flavors. This journey explores some of the timeless classics that define this culinary art form.

**The Éclair:** An oblong choux pastry, typically filled with cream and topped with flavored icing. Its name means 'flash of lightning'.

**The Macaron:** A delicate meringue-based confection with a smooth, crisp shell and a moist, chewy interior, sandwiching a flavorful filling.

**The Mille-Feuille (Napoleon):** Meaning 'a thousand sheets', this pastry is made of layers of puff pastry alternating with pastry cream.

These are just a few examples. The world of French pâtisserie is vast and continues to inspire.
